title: Santa Clarita, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Santa Clarita, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Santa Clarita is a city in CA with a population of 210,000. Master-planned Valencia community with excellent schools and mountain backdrop. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
